peak: A volcano with one tall cone. Visible from far off, which is its only virtue.
A single steep peak. The locals say it last erupted out of spite.
Tall, pointy, smoking slightly. Like a disappointed admiral.
atoll: Flat as a ship's biscuit. You'll see the palms before you see the land.
A low ring of sand and palms. Mind the reef; it minds nobody.
Barely above the waterline. The tide has opinions about it.
twin: Two hills with a saddle between them. Sailors call it something rude.
Twin humps, one taller. Looks like a camel that gave up.
Two green hills side by side, arguing about which one is the island.
